channel: Gigi personal LinkedIn (manual post, not auto-published)

slides.headline_top: Your best buyer sent a PO.
slides.sub: Now line 14 is the wrong part.
slides.alt: Tired rep retyping a purchase order PDF on Friday at 4:58 pm.

slides.headline: It lands at 4:58 on Friday
slides.body: Forty lines. One tired rep. Two screens. A promise to ship Monday.
slides.alt: Wall clock at 4:58 above a rep facing a long purchase order.

slides.headline: Retyping adds a second author
slides.body: Every digit gets typed again. One swapped digit and a different part is on the pallet.
slides.alt: Two near identical part numbers with one digit swapped, glowing red.

slides.headline: The buyer finds out last
slides.body: The box opens Tuesday at their dock. The invoice is already out. Trust takes the hit.
slides.alt: Buyer at a loading dock opening a box with the wrong part.

slides.headline: A store should end this
slides.body: When buyers key their own order, they own the typo. Nobody on your team inherits the blame.
slides.alt: Buyer placing their own order on a laptop with a green confirmation glow.

slides.headline: Count them this week
slides.body: Tally every PO that arrives as a file. Each one is a chance to retype.
slides.alt: Stack of printed purchase orders with a hand making tally marks.
